title: WOFOST One-Day Rate State View Assembly
goal: Implement the smallest production seam required by F-WOF27: assemble a compact semantic read-only pre-event WOFOST rate-state view without exposing future rate physics to crop-owner biomass internals.

production_scope.output_presence: inactive crop returns available=false with no active canopy-parameter dependency; emerged valid crop returns available=true

architectural_boundary.reason: the assembler is the explicit translation boundary from authoritative crop owner state to semantic rate inputs

fail_closed_rules: active view requires finite nonnegative SSA and SPA
active DVS must be finite and nonnegative
all assembled biomass and LAI scalars must be finite and nonnegative
inactive route returns before inspecting SSA or SPA
tests: inactive owner produces unavailable zero view and ignores invalid active-only canopy coefficients
active view exactly matches authoritative DVS, organ biomass, living leaf biomass, derived LAI and LAIEXP
assembly cannot mutate owner or cohort arrays
negative or nonfinite SSA/SPA fail closed for active crops
O0 and O2 outputs are identical
F-WOF26 structural semantics remain regression-compatible under explicit recompilation
forbidden: copying leaf cohort arrays into the rate-state view
